insight.description: Distinguishes sustained commercial operations and demonstrated delivery activity from pilots, plans, or announcements when judging which vendors lead.
Draws meaningful comparisons among vendors’ competitive strengths and limitations rather than presenting them as an undifferentiated list.
Explains how differences in operating environments, including regulatory conditions, affect vendors’ ability to deploy and compete.
Offers a clear, appropriately qualified judgment about who leads and recognizes where leadership may vary or remain uncertain.

readability.description: Presents ideas in a coherent structure with transitions that make the reasoning easy to follow.
Uses clear, parallel phrasing when comparing vendors so readers can readily understand how the stated differences relate.
Uses concise sentences and precise wording, avoiding confusing references, repetition, and unnecessary jargon for a student or junior researcher in the field.
